answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 4644 Country: India Title: I am a girl. Sometimes wetness occurs when we hear about sex even though we do not have the intention of indulging in sinful and immoral thoughts. Is that wetness impure and do we have to perform ghusal after that? Question: I am a girl. Sometimes wetness occurs when we hear about sex even though we do not have the intention of indulging in sinful and immoral thoughts. Is that wetness impure and do we have to perform ghusal after that? Answer ID: 4644 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 507/507=M-1429) If, due to hearing about sex, semen is discharged with lust (the sign of it is that it is thick and one feels relaxed after ejaculation and excitement turns into coldness), then ghusl will be obligatory. If the wetness is not thick but it is thin and excitement does not become dull after discharge rather it increases, then that is mazi (pre-seminal fluid), because of this only wudu is broken, ghusl will not be obligatory. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
